remarks: Tucked away at the end of a leafy cul de sac, this GORGEOUS home is the one you have been waiting for. With a superb floor plan and tastefully finished throughout, this 4 bedroom 2.5 bath home oozes with finesse. The kitchen has terrific counter space for entertaining and food prep and with the open concept family/dining room, you will not miss a beat. A formal living room with fireplace and a generous dining room lend themselves to spaces for fun get togethers. A laundry room and half bath complete the main floor. Upstairs there are 4 bedrooms. The primary has a walk in closet and full bath. 3 additional bedrooms, a full bath and large linen closet complete this floor. Downstairs, the finished LL space can be used as a family room/gym, home office, etc. Outside the deck and flat yard are a great place to play and relax in. Gleaming hardwood flooring throughout and in immaculate condition this home is hard to beat. And, all this conveniently located mins to downtown and the parkway. What's not to love!
